channel.title: AI Threat Watch: threats on the wire
channel.description: Headlines the robot classified as incidents or exploited flaws, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: 印度多家金融机构遭人工智能驱动攻击 至少两款工具与中国有关
item.description: RFI: Several Indian financial institutions were hit by AI-driven attacks, with at least two of the tools reportedly linked to China.

item.title: Хакеры атаковали индийские финансовые учреждения с помощью китайского ИИ
item.description: Дзеркало тижня: Hackers reportedly attacked Indian financial institutions using Chinese AI tools.

item.title: 印度金融机构遭AI网络攻击 部分黑客工具被指同中国有关
item.description: 8world: Indian financial institutions suffered AI-driven cyberattacks, with some hacking tools reportedly linked to China.

item.title: One Hacker Uses 12 AI Agents to Breach Taiwan's Emergency Services and Steal Sensitive Data
item.description: CyberSecurityNews: A single hacker reportedly used 12 AI agents to breach Taiwan's emergency services and steal sensitive data.

item.title: Chainalysis warns all users hit in cyber breach involving ‘agentic’ techniques
item.description: The Record: Chainalysis says some information belonging to all its users was exposed in a breach involving agentic techniques.

item.title: 印度金融机构遭AI黑客攻击 至少两款工具关联中国
item.description: 联合早报: Indian financial institutions hit by AI-assisted hackers, with at least two tools linked to China.

item.title: Интеллект искусственный, конфуз настоящий: ИИ-агент Meta* открыл переписки сотрудников компании
item.description: SecurityLab.ru: A Meta AI agent reportedly opened employees' private conversations, according to SecurityLab.

item.title: AI-Powered BOSSAI Attacks Expose Patient Records and Emergency Dispatch Data in Taiwan
item.description: GBHackers: The BOSSAI agentic attack platform, run by one operator, exposed Taipei emergency medical and dispatch data and targeted hundreds of organisations in 11 countries.

item.title: Binance piratage 2026 : comment les hackers ont-ils détourné 6,34 milliards de dollars ?
item.description: EmarketerZ: French outlet explains how hackers allegedly diverted $6.34 billion from Binance, an event already tracked.

item.title: Полмиллиона запросов за 8 часов. Хакеры продавали безлимитный ИИ по $60, а счёт почти на $1 млн прислали жертве
item.description: SecurityLab.ru: Hackers sold unlimited AI access for $60 after 500,000 requests in 8 hours, leaving the victim a bill near $1 million.

item.title: Мошенники с помощью ИИ шантажируют пользователей сайтов знакомств
item.description: Techora.ru: Russian outlet reports scammers using AI to blackmail users of dating sites; no specific case details are given.

item.title: ¿Cómo hackearon Binance?: Delincuentes usaron falsas entrevistas laborales e inteligencia artificial
item.description: Comercio TV: Spanish-language report says the Binance attackers used fake job interviews and AI.
